technical.summary: Oversold conditions with early stochastic reversal signal present, but severe lack of bullish confirmation across momentum, trend, and price structure indicators creates low-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 2 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) with recent bipartisan congressional purchases 84-85 days ago suggest contrarian buy opportunity, though conviction is moderate and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX at 294.6, FOMC in 1 day) combined with earnings binary event in 2 days create extreme risk environment for ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 oversold with stochastic cross-up and congressional bipartisan buying in extreme fear environment (16/100) create contrarian reversal setup near support at 256.17.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 2 days + FOMC in 1 day + inverted yield curve + crisis VIX (294.6) + price below all major MAs + MACD bearish + no momentum confirmation = unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While RSI oversold and congressional buying suggest contrarian opportunity in extreme fear, earnings binary in 2 days combined with FOMC decision in 1 day creates unacceptable risk concentration that negates technical setup quality.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 2 days will trigger volatility spike; existing ACN position + 1 other IT holding + 17 total open positions creates excessive sector and portfolio concentration risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance despite contrarian sentiment signal
